credits.title: Club Kid
credits.overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

credits.title: Your Name Isn't English
credits.overview: Each time Tazbah, a young professional woman gets into a ride-share car she takes on the unexpected role of becoming a free history teacher as her drivers struggle to pronounce her name.

credits.title: A Good Man
credits.overview: Biased or brave? Savior or culprit? When a man believes he’s about to save a young girl, he loses a part of himself.

credits.title: What It Was
credits.overview: An old flame is reignited and a new desire is awaken when Hollywood Actress Adina J. Spencer returns back to New York. Soon she is forced to face her sexual past, confront her present identity, and admit her true love.
